body:
## Pull request overview

This PR brings `@objectstack/plugin-auth` in line with the ObjectStack Protocol by converting kernel object field keys to `snake_case`, and adds ObjectStack CLI scripts/config so the plugin can be validated/compiled via `objectstack` commands.

**Changes:**
- Renamed camelCase field keys to snake_case across 4 auth objects, updating related layouts and indexes.
- Added `objectstack.config.ts` stack definition exporting auth objects via `defineStack()`.
- Added `validate/compile/info` scripts plus `@objectstack/cli` dev dependency (and lockfile entry).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds workspace link for `@objectstack/cli` under plugin-auth importer. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-user.object.ts | Renames fields to snake_case and updates compact layout + indexes accordingly. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-session.object.ts | Renames fields to snake_case and updates compact layout + indexes accordingly. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-account.object.ts | Renames fields to snake_case and updates title format, compact layout, + indexes accordingly. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objects/auth-verification.object.ts | Renames fields to snake_case and updates compact layout + indexes accordingly. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json | Adds ObjectStack CLI scripts and `@objectstack/cli` dev dependency. |
| packages/plugins/plugin-auth/objectstack.config.ts | Introduces a stack config used by the CLI to validate/compile plugin metadata. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

`objectstack.config.ts` is loaded by the CLI via `bundle-require`/esbuild. Importing `./src/objects` currently pulls in `src/objects/index.ts`, which re-exports using `.js` specifiers (e.g. `./auth-user.object.js`) that don’t exist in source, so `objectstack validate/compile/info` will fail to load this config. Consider importing the four object files directly (extensionless TS paths) or updating the barrel exports to be extensionless so esbuild can resolve the `.ts` sources.
